title: The Olympia band and its bass players
summary: He liked the Olympia dance band; they recall its players, the Young Olympia and the Morera bass players.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. Um, can you tell us any about the dance orchestras in those days? Any of the dance orchestras you liked?
Well, I liked the Olympia band. The Olympia band, that was a pretty good band to mine. Who was the leader of that?
I know all the past. I know all the past. I know all the past.
That's the band Big 8. That's the band Trumbone with.
Oh yeah. Who else is in the, who's the, uh, coronetist in the Olympia band? Do you remember? Cucu. Cucu, with a cow. Oh yeah, a cow.

Not at that time, I don't know. I forgot the fella, but I mean, still, I remember Cucu was playing with him, but. The half of it before Cucu? Oh yeah. I think one time, even Frederick Heppard was in the Olympia, way back. Was there a young Olympia?

I don't know, it seems like. They had two Olympia. I think so. They had the old Olympia and they had the young Olympia. I believe Ricard Alexis told us once that he started out in the young Olympia or something. That's right.

I don't know who was in the man's up there. I think Simon Morera, I think, was managing the young Olympia. Yeah, he was managing the young Olympia band. The bass player. That's right. One, two, one. See, one time, I know, Billy Moran had that band together. They had the Olympia band together. Yeah.
Yeah, old man. Eddie Moran, daddy. Oh yeah. Billy Moran. He was calling Billy Moran. He was an old bass player. Oh yeah. In other words, he was doing Mr. Glenny's time, old man Glenny's time. Yeah.
He was the manager of the Superior band too, I think, way back.

That's right. That's right. That's right. But him and I had that band together. I remember that. That's years ago. I mean, that's years ago. Then his son, Simon made a band, a young Olympia. He had two sons playing in that band. John, Marera and Simon. Simon. Simon. Yeah.
